==================================================================================================================================
REMITTANCE & RECOVERY PROCESS - CP-2024-1187 (PROCEDURAL WALKTHROUGH; NO PAYMENT EXECUTED)
==================================================================================================================================

NOTE: All figures below are HYPOTHETICAL for arithmetic illustration only. No claim amount has been established.

--- 1. REMITTANCE CALCULATION WATERFALL (hypothetical inputs) ---
                                   Step  Amount ($)                                                                     Note
1. Covered loss at RCV (post sub-limit)  217,000.00 Building 180,000 + BPP 25,000 + moldsub 12,000 (capped at 15,000) + BI 0
                  2. Coinsurance factor  217,000.00                               N/A - no coinsurance penalty / not applied
                3. Policy limit applied  217,000.00                                                 min(loss, limit 500,000)
                     4. Less deductible  212,000.00                                                 - 5,000 (per occurrence)
               5. Initial (ACV) payment  167,000.00                       net owed 212,000 - recoverable depreciation 45,000
  6. Held-back recoverable depreciation   45,000.00                   payable only on proof of repair/replacement after loss
  7. Recoverable depreciation - trigger   45,000.00              released on completion of repairs, within policy time limit

  Net owed (post-deductible): $212,000.00
  Initial ACV payment:        $167,000.00
  Recoverable depreciation:   $45,000.00 (held, released on completion)

--- 2. PAYEE / ISSUANCE MECHANICS ---
                            Party                Status                                                                 Treatment
                    Named insured Harborview Retail LLC                                               First party - primary payee
Mortgagee / loss payee (building)   [LENDER TO CONFIRM] Building loss drafts are typically issued jointly per the mortgage clause
        Loss payee (contents/BPP)          [TO CONFIRM]                Only if a secured interest exists in contents - often none
     Public adjuster fee (if any)        [NONE ON FILE]      Never paid from the carrier draft; PA billed separately by agreement
                       Deductible   Retained by insured                                   Not remitted - deducted before issuance

--- 3. SUBROGATION WORKFLOW ---
#                                             Step      Timing                                                                                                      Action                                        Instrument
1                    Preserve evidence & artifacts Immediately Failed pipe section/fitting retained unaltered; photos of the failure point; do not discard during repairs. Preservation letter to insured/restoration vendor
2                     Cause & origin determination    <30 days                                       Establish whether a third party caused or contributed to the failure.                           Engineer/plumber report
3                          Subrogation screen memo    <45 days                                          Decide pursue/decline with written rationale; document SOL expiry.      Sol clock = 3 yrs from DOL (RCW 4.16.080(2))
4         Confirm SOL & any contractual limitation    <45 days                                               Diary the earliest expiry; tolling agreement if near the bar.                                 Tolling agreement
5           Notice/preservation letters to targets    <60 days                                                 Preserve carrier's rights; put potential targets on notice.   Letter to contractor/manufacturer as applicable
6 Obtain contracts, warranties, invoices, licenses    <60 days                                                           Identify the party bound and the applicable duty.                                       EV-29/31/40
7                             Demand / negotiation  as pursued                                                                 Subrogation demand with supporting quantum.                                    Demand package
8                          File suit if unresolved  before SOL                                                          File in Washington superior court or agreed forum.                         Complaint + expert report
9                                  Recover & apply  on receipt                Reimburse claim file net of costs; account to insured for any deductible/recoverable deprec.                                  Recovery receipt

--- 4. ILLUSTRATIVE NET-RECOVERY MATH ---
                                                Item      Amount                                                                             Note
                          Gross subrogation recovery $120,000.00                                              ILLUSTRATIVE - no recovery asserted
Less allocable costs (experts, attorney, collection)  $18,000.00                                              Typically pro-rata to carrier first
                             Net recovery to carrier $102,000.00                                     Reimburses amounts the carrier actually paid
    Insured's deductible (Uninsured/under-recovered)   $5,000.00                              Accounted to insured on a made-whole basis (WA law)
                                   Made-whole caveat     Applies Undersigned may need to be made whole before carrier shares in recovery - WA law
